import random

def generate_sequence(n, length):
    s = ''.join(random.choice('abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ') for _ in range(length))
    return s

def count_subsequences(s, p):
    from itertools import combinations
    count = 0
    len_p = len(p)
    for combo in combinations(range(len(s)), len_p):
        if all(s[i] == p[j] for j, i in enumerate(combo)):
            count += 1
    return count

def main():
    n = int(input().strip())
    length_s = random.randint(1, 200)
    length_p = random.randint(1, 200)
    
    s = generate_sequence(n, length_s)
    p = generate_sequence(1, length_p)
    
    while count_subsequences(s, p) != n:
        s = generate_sequence(n, length_s)
        p = generate_sequence(1, length_p)
    
    print(s, p)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
